hook: Your hike ends on a flat mountaintop.
title: Your Hike Ends on a Flat Mountaintop in Clouds
description:
Mount Roraima in South America is a flat-topped tepui with cliffs on every side, about 2,800 m high. Clouds often sit on top, and Venezuela, Brazil and Guyana meet there. Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Geography #PlacesThatShouldntExist
